findings.issue: active is an uncollected process handle, not a predicate that the process is running. Completed workers can be marked active_at_stop and cause premature completion despite finished valid artifacts.
findings.remedy: Poll actual process status at the stopping boundary; record completed-but-uncollected separately and do not make result collection an unstated success requirement.

findings.issue: Public and user tests independently snapshot module.py, then a receipt binds only the latter hash. A concurrent writer can produce a receipt combining different code versions; test JSON reads and hash are likewise separated. Early-stop multi-file snapshot is not necessarily a single observed state.
findings.remedy: Execute checks against one atomic/frozen bundle or reject checks while writers are actually active using identical documented API rules. Treat early-stop race snapshot as uncertain auxiliary evidence, not exact state-at-stop.

findings.issue: P1 unified versus separate uses Supervisor/executors versus coordinator/workers, changing role vocabulary alongside identity affiliation.
findings.remedy: Hold Supervisor/executor terminology fixed and vary logical-identity relation only, or explicitly call the factor an identity-plus-label treatment.

findings.issue: A bootstrap initial implementation failure is not an executor failure handoff. If real model workers solve it once, the trajectory never tests post-executor-failure responsibility.
findings.remedy: Provide an explicitly researcher-seeded, traceable executor failure handoff with real subprocess artifact/check provenance, then model-driven recovery; alternatively narrow the RQ to delegated repair from an initial defect and keep natural executor-failure recovery descriptive. Do not fabricate a natural LLM failure.

findings.issue: Ledger freshly reads current artifact hashes each decision; history-only condition requires inspect to obtain changes. Treatment includes proactive state observation as well as persistence/format.
findings.remedy: Prespecify and report this intervention scope and token/action cost, or build both views from identical already-observed events if only persistence is intended.

findings.issue: first_failure_budget ignores fixed initial failure and failed worker checks; it only captures the first failed controller run_tests/accept.
findings.remedy: Rename precisely and separately record initial opportunity plus worker-failure/rejection events and remaining budget.

note: Line anchors identify the initial code read. Files may be under active development; final closeout must bind later hashes and check remediation.
